data.verdict: HeckeSideS5Symmetry premise is SATISFIABLE for the actual (4,1) block: an S₅ action ρS' on the Hecke space (ρS'(s)=T·ρS(s)·T⁻¹, T the G_M↦G_std congruence) leaves the Markov Gram invariant (resid 1.24e-40), conjugates to the geometric S₅ (resid 1.15e-41), and MATCHES characters (trace ρS'=trace ρS, resid 2.3e-41) — so the intertwiner_trace_eq obstruction that KILLS the generator route (Hecke trace 2.43 ≠ 2) does NOT apply here. This confirms markovGram_transports_to_hodge (#4199) is a genuine, NON-vacuous reduction. STRICT: T is AN arbitrary congruence, not the canonical Tits *-iso (which the q-deformation pins); so |c| still needs the canonical τ. No instance registered; 1/(8π) phase-4; nothing wired.

caveats: T is AN arbitrary G_M↦G_std congruence, NOT the canonical Tits *-iso (pinned by the q-deformation). This proves the structure is inhabitable (contrast: the generator-intertwiner is provably not); it does NOT pin |c|, which still needs the canonical τ.
